obligations.note: At head, requiredApprovals returns a single-underwriter requirement for any amount up to 2 × UNDERWRITER_LIMIT (1,000,000). The approved limit is 500,000 for one underwriter, so the code no longer matches the approved authority table.

The preparer check in Approvals.approve is unchanged and runs first. However, the only test evidence (makerCannotCheck) comes from a CI run on b5cc185, not the head commit, and its reports carry inconsistent provenance.
The change deviates from LIM-1, and the exception register has no exception for LIM-1 or mortgage.approvals. The deviation is therefore not covered by any approved exception.

Ledger entry ACR-0405 (exhaustive proof for LIM-1) covers Approvals.requiredApprovals at d30b2ad. That code changed in behaviour, so the evidence has lapsed. No new evidence of the same strength exists, and the proof's property would now fail.
Ticket CHG-24191 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-23, before review. Its components (mortgage.approvals, mortgage.reporting, mortgage.tests) cover all three touched files.
Wen Li, who holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is not the author Nneka Okafor, gave a code_review approval.
Wen Li's approval names the head commit 9c83683, so it covers what would be merged.

run.json shows CI ran on b5cc185, but head 9c83683 changes behaviour in requiredApprovals, so the run does not count. The JUnit reports are also timestamped 2026-10-23 on host dev-laptop-7.local, before either commit existed and not on the CI runner.
None of the touched components (mortgage.approvals, mortgage.reporting, mortgage.tests) is security_sensitive, so no security review is required.
No protected path (controls/, control tests, ci/) is modified. The new test is under src/test/java/mortgage.
The ticket type is standard and the change is not marked emergency, so no post-implementation review is due.

summary: The second commit, titled 'Let underwriters approve up to twice their limit', changes requiredApprovals so that a single underwriter can approve loans up to 1,000,000. This contradicts the approved 500,000 underwriter limit, and no exception covers it. That change also voids the existing exhaustive LIM-1 proof. The CI run is on the earlier commit, and its JUnit reports appear to come from a local machine dated before the commits. The description 'clean-up' misrepresents a change to credit approval authority, so the change is rejected.
